description: Rename and relocate the password-reset route pair (option A). Rename useCases/auth/forgotPassword -> useCases/auth/requestPasswordReset (route POST /password-reset/request) and move+rename useCases/profile/resetPassword -> useCases/auth/confirmPassword (route POST /password-reset/confirm). Update the two route files and the two e2e specs. This is one atomic feature: the route files import the renamed identifiers, so the whole rename must land together to keep the project buildable. Rename ONLY the backend use-case layer and the two HTTP route paths; preserve TokenTypeEnum['forgot-password'], EMAIL_JOB_NAMES.forgotPassword, the email template (forgotPassword/ForgotPassword/ForgotPasswordProps/forgotPasswordTemplate + ITemplateProvider.forgotPassword), FRONTEND_PAGE_PATHS.resetPassword, and the confirmPassword body field. See context.json do_not_rename_preserved. All code, comments, and test descriptions in English.
steps: Use case A — rename folder + files with git mv (preserve history). In src/core/accounts/useCases/auth/: rename folder forgotPassword/ -> requestPasswordReset/, then rename files: ForgotPassword.service.ts -> RequestPasswordReset.service.ts; forgotPassword.controller.ts -> requestPasswordReset.controller.ts; forgotPassword.container.ts -> requestPasswordReset.container.ts; forgotPassword.schema.ts -> requestPasswordReset.schema.ts; forgotPassword.dtos.ts -> requestPasswordReset.dtos.ts; forgotPassword.spec.ts -> requestPasswordReset.spec.ts.

Use case A — update identifiers. RequestPasswordReset.service.ts: class ForgotPasswordService -> RequestPasswordResetService; import type ForgotPassword -> RequestPasswordReset from './requestPasswordReset.dtos'; BadRequestError path tags 'ForgotPassword.service.1'/'.2' -> 'RequestPasswordReset.service.1'/'.2'. KEEP TokenTypeEnum['forgot-password'], this.templateProvider.forgotPassword(...), FRONTEND_PAGE_PATHS.resetPassword. requestPasswordReset.schema.ts: const forgotPasswordSchema -> requestPasswordResetSchema. requestPasswordReset.dtos.ts: import { requestPasswordResetSchema } from './requestPasswordReset.schema'; type ForgotPasswordReqBody -> RequestPasswordResetReqBody; type ForgotPassword -> RequestPasswordReset. requestPasswordReset.controller.ts: imports RequestPasswordResetReqBody from './requestPasswordReset.dtos' and resolveRequestPasswordResetService from './requestPasswordReset.container'; const forgotPasswordController -> requestPasswordResetController. requestPasswordReset.container.ts: import RequestPasswordResetService from './RequestPasswordReset.service'; const forgotPasswordService -> requestPasswordResetService; export resolveForgotPasswordService -> resolveRequestPasswordResetService. requestPasswordReset.spec.ts: import RequestPasswordResetService from './RequestPasswordReset.service'; update typed var + new ...Service(...); describe('ForgotPassword') -> describe('RequestPasswordReset'); reword it(...) texts about 'forgot password' to 'request password reset'. KEEP TokenTypeEnum['forgot-password'] in test setup.

Use case B — move + rename with git mv. git mv src/core/accounts/useCases/profile/resetPassword src/core/accounts/useCases/auth/confirmPassword, then rename files: ResetPassword.service.ts -> ConfirmPassword.service.ts; resetPassword.controller.ts -> confirmPassword.controller.ts; resetPassword.container.ts -> confirmPassword.container.ts; resetPassword.schema.ts -> confirmPassword.schema.ts; resetPassword.dtos.ts -> confirmPassword.dtos.ts; resetPassword.spec.ts -> confirmPassword.spec.ts. All imports in these files use the @/ alias plus in-folder ./ imports; the move keeps @/ imports valid (useCases/auth and useCases/profile are at the same depth).

Use case B — update identifiers. ConfirmPassword.service.ts: class ResetPasswordService -> ConfirmPasswordService; import type ResetPassword -> ConfirmPassword from './confirmPassword.dtos'; BadRequestError path tags 'ResetPassword.service.1'/'.2'/'.3' -> 'ConfirmPassword.service.1'/'.2'/'.3'. confirmPassword.schema.ts: const resetPasswordSchema -> confirmPasswordSchema; KEEP the inner body field confirmPassword and the password === confirmPassword refinement exactly as-is. confirmPassword.dtos.ts: import { confirmPasswordSchema } from './confirmPassword.schema'; type ResetPasswordReqBody -> ConfirmPasswordReqBody; type ResetPassword -> ConfirmPassword. confirmPassword.controller.ts: imports ConfirmPasswordReqBody from './confirmPassword.dtos' and resolveConfirmPasswordService from './confirmPassword.container'; const resetPasswordController -> confirmPasswordController. confirmPassword.container.ts: import ConfirmPasswordService from './ConfirmPassword.service'; const resetPasswordService -> confirmPasswordService; export resolveResetPasswordService -> resolveConfirmPasswordService. confirmPassword.spec.ts: import ConfirmPasswordService from './ConfirmPassword.service'; update typed var + new ...Service(...); describe('Reset Password') -> describe('Confirm Password'); reword it(...) texts about 'reset the password' to 'confirm password' wording. KEEP TokenTypeEnum['forgot-password'] in test setup.

Routes — auth.routes.ts (src/infrastructure/fastify/routes/auth.routes.ts). Replace imports forgotPasswordSchema/forgotPasswordController with requestPasswordResetSchema (from @/core/accounts/useCases/auth/requestPasswordReset/requestPasswordReset.schema) and requestPasswordResetController (from .../requestPasswordReset.controller). Change the existing POST '/forgot-password' registration to POST '/password-reset/request' with body: requestPasswordResetSchema, handler requestPasswordResetController, tags ['Auth'], summary: 'Request Password Reset', description: 'Sends a password reset link to the user email'. Add imports confirmPasswordSchema/confirmPasswordController from @/core/accounts/useCases/auth/confirmPassword/... and register POST '/password-reset/confirm' with body: confirmPasswordSchema, handler confirmPasswordController, tags ['Auth'], summary: 'Confirm Password Reset', description: 'Sets a new password using the password reset token'.

Routes — profile.routes.ts (src/infrastructure/fastify/routes/profile.routes.ts). Delete the POST '/reset-password' registration block AND the now-unused imports resetPasswordSchema and resetPasswordController (eslint fails on unused imports). Leave /me (GET/PATCH/DELETE) and /update-password untouched.

E2E — confirm. git mv src/infrastructure/fastify/tests/profile/resetPassword.e2e-spec.ts src/infrastructure/fastify/tests/auth/confirmPassword.e2e-spec.ts. The relative import ../helpers/authentication.helpers stays valid (profile/ and auth/ are both one level under tests/). Update request path .post('/reset-password') -> .post('/password-reset/confirm'); describe('Reset Password') -> describe('Confirm Password'). KEEP TokenTypeEnum['forgot-password'] and the expires_at field it passes.

E2E — request. git mv src/infrastructure/fastify/tests/auth/forgotPassword.e2e-spec.ts src/infrastructure/fastify/tests/auth/requestPasswordReset.e2e-spec.ts. Update request path .post('/forgot-password') -> .post('/password-reset/request'); describe('Forgot Password') -> describe('Request Password Reset').
Commit locally on the current branch (develop); stage only the files this task touches (do not stage pre-existing unrelated changes); never push.
